title: 2022 CODATA: Stefan-Boltzmann constant is 5.670 374 419... × 10^−8
summary: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks Stefan-Boltzmann constant as exact: 5.670 374 419...
body: The 2022 CODATA complete listing, from NIST, marks Stefan-Boltzmann constant as exact: 5.670 374 419... × 10^−8 W m^-2 K^-4. The ellipsis is in the file. No further digits are added here. The Stefan-Boltzmann constant sets the power per area of a black-body radiator as proportional to the fourth power of temperature. The 2022 listing marks the value exact and prints an ellipsis.
